The Celebes Cubers Community presents Clash Of Cubers : Celebes Speedcubing Masters 2024 which is a Official speedcubing competition which will be held for 2 days with 3x3x3 as the main event and will be held at Main Atrium The Nipah Mall Makasar. This competition is open to all citizenship.

We will not accept your registration if you have not confirmed it with us. For further information, please reach out to the contact provided
